Forking Paths Among the Stars

Quest Type

Summary[]

You encounter Camellya at the Black Shores' Greenhouse. As usual, she appears nonchalant but pleased nevertheless to chat. Your conversation is interrupted by Beatrice, who needs you to handle a problem at the Error Cell.

A corrupted Stellar Matrix has escaped and could endanger the Black Shores. To retrieve it, you seek the Consultant who previously accessed the Matrix's data.

The Consultant reveals the data was intentionally erased, but it involves the leader of the Black Shores—your past self—and a Bloom Bearer named Lady Flora. You learn that you once saved Lady Flora from Petalfall Village and shared a deep bond, but she vanished twenty years ago.

At the Hall of Foreign Affairs, you discover that Camellya has already taken Lady Flora's belongings. Now, you must find Camellya.

After catching up with Camellya, she reveals that she is Lady Flora, but like you, she has lost her memories. She appears indifferent to everything except you and proposes a game in exchange for hanging over Flora's items.

Camellya enjoyed the game and gives you the bracelet as promised. Recognizing that her help is vital to resolving the current crisis, you ask her to stay. Camellya finds your assertiveness intriguing and agrees to help. In a discussion about self and her lost memories, Camellya claims her instincts define who she is. To gather more of Lady Flora's items, you decide to split up.

You continue searching and find a forsaken Blake Bloom in a cave.

Camellya shows signs of Overclocking from battle, yet she appears unconcerned. She is accustomed to enduring pain and explains that savoring each present moment is her way of coping.

From the Blake Bloom's frequency, you discover that Lady Flora disappeared around the same time as the Black Shores leader. With enough items gathered, you head to the Modulation Hall.

After Beatrice completes the modulation, you and Camellya dive into the stars to locate the escaped Stellar Matrix.

During the dive, something goes wrong. You lose contact with Camellya and the Modulation Hall.

On the other side of the Stargate, you find yourself in a strange cave. There, an illusion of Lady Flora, resembling Camellya, appears before you.

You learn that Lady Flora sealed her memories because of a choice your past self made. Bewildered, you return to the Modulation Hall with Beatrice's help.

Beatrice informs you that Camellya is still trapped in the Stellar Matrix. To rescue her, you must enter the Matrix once again. Beatrice warns you that multiple jumps might be needed to reach the correct timeline juncture.

Upon crossing the Stargate, you find yourself in a simulated Black Shores from many years ago. There, you encounter a nervous robot, KU-Riri, who tells you that Lady Flora is Overclocking and has fled her medical pod to hide in a nearby room. This suggests you are not in the correct juncture, but rather a distorted version of history.

You find Lady Flora covered in vines, struggling against her Overclocking. As her condition eases, she gazes at you with a faint smile and offers you a flower.

Crossing the Stargate again, you meet another version of Lady Flora at the Black Shores. Unlike the previous Lady Flora, she appears healthy and slightly bashful, yet her admiration for you remains unchanged. She mentions that meeting you feels familiar.

Thanks to your timely arrival, Petalfall Village has survived the disaster in this juncture, even though that is not how it truly happened. Like she did before, Lady Flora smiles and offers you a flower.

After passing through the Stargate for the third time, you finally reach the correct timeline juncture.

The Lady Flora you meet resembles Camellya in the real world and, like the others, she does not hide her feelings for you.

After losing contact with you, Camellya crosses the Stargate and finds herself in the cave from the past. Like you, she has jumped through many simulated worlds and witnessed different possibilities, but her path always crosses with yours.

Intrigued by the Lady Flora illusion in front of her, Camellya decides to follow.

Lady Flora explains that the past duties imposed on the one she yearns for led to their decision to leave the Black Shores. Camellya listens to her past self, surprised by her depth of emotion. Through Lady Flora's words, Camellya realizes that you are the leader of the Black Shores.

Lady Flora's condition has gradually worsened ever since she lost her Anchor. As memories from before her arrival at Petalfall Village resurface, her Overlocking symptoms intensify. Camellya struggles to understand what it means to care about others.

Lady Flora refuses treatment, fearing it will leave her with nothing. Without her power, she would feel forever inferior to the one she cherishes, a fate she cannot accept. The heavy atmosphere triggers Camellya's own Overclocking symptoms to flare up.

To put an end to her severe Overclocking, Lady Flora decides to abandon her memories, including all those of you. She believes that her connection to you is intrinsic to her nature and will ultimately guide her back to you. When that day arrives, she hopes to stand as their equal.

Watching her past self, Camellya acknowledges and accepts this choice.

You find yourself reunited with Camellya. Considering the years apart, this reunion has been ten years in the making. In every world, you and she have met, parted, and reunited again. If this is your fate, Camellya embraces it willingly.

With the Stellar Matrix defeated, the two of you return home.

With the Stellar Matrices back in order, Camellya invites you to Veiled Rock.

Camellya asks you to take a photo of this moment as a way to capture her current feelings.

Once trapped in a labyrinth of memories and possibilities, Camellya has lost much. But now, she tells you she no longer wishes to recover her lost memories, believing the seal left by Lady Flora will naturally break when the time is right.

What matters to her now is enjoying this reunion with you.

Just as she did in previous timeline junctures, Camellya smiles and extends her hand, offering you a flower.

Steps[]

  1. Head to the Greenhouse
  2. Head to the Error Cell
  3. Look for the Consultant
  4. Talk to the Consultant
  5. Head to the Hall of Foreign Affairs
  6. Catch up with Camellya
  7. Fight Tacet Discords
  8. Look for Lady Flora's items
  9. Enter the cave
  10. Look for Rover
  11. Defeat all enemies
  12. Head to the Modulation Hall
  13. Investigate the cave
    1. Whispers of Lady Flora drift from somewhere up ahead
    2. Follow Lady Flora's illusion
  14. Dive into the stars and retrieve the corrupted Stellar Matrix
    1. Talk to KU-Riri
    2. Inspect the gate
    3. Destroy the vines sealing the gate
    4. Enter the room
    5. Look for the Overclocking Camellya
    6. Jump to the next timeline juncture
    7. Explore the second timeline juncture
    8. Investigate the item on the ground
    9. Talk to the Black Shores Gardener
    10. Explore the shoreline
    11. Jump to the next timeline juncture
    12. Investigate further
    13. Pick up the flower seed
    14. Use the flower seed to open the door
    15. Proceed forward
    16. Use "Ephemeral" to clear the thorns
    17. Continue forward
    18. Approach Lady Flora
    19. Search for Lady Flora
    20. Interact with Lady Flora's illusion
    21. Defeat the digital TDs
    22. Proceed forward
    23. Pick up the flower seed and unveil the path
    24. Use the flower seed to open the door
    25. Defeat the digital TDs
    26. Approach Lady Flora
    27. Search for Lady Flora
    28. Interact with Lady Flora's illusion
    29. Defeat the Stellar Matrix Core
  15. Deliver the Stellar Matrix
    1. Leave the Stars
  16. Head to Veiled Rock
  17. Follow Camellya
  18. Take a photo of Camellya
  19. Use your Camera to capture her
  20. Take a photo with Camellya

Gameplay Notes[]

  • Completing the "Look for Lady Flora's items" step will grant the player The Forgotten Blake Bloom.
  • Completing the "Defeat all enemies" step will grant the player Lady Flora's Bracelet and Tattered Photos.
  • Completing the quest will award the player Moments with You trophy I Offer You the Memory of a Camellia, Her Bracelet, as well as change the description for Tattered Photos.
  • Talking to Camellya between 00:00-06:59 after completing the quest will award the player Moments with You trophy Yet Another Sunrise

Dialogue[]

The newly planted flowers in the Greenhouse have bloomed. Go take a look.
(Head to the designated location)
Camellya: Aha, you're finally here.
Camellya: It's been a while, my sweet seed of fate.
Camellya: Are you here for the flowers? Perfect timing. They're about to bloom.
Camellya: Consultants roam all across Solaris, and when they return, they always bring rare flower seeds as souvenirs.
You like flowers?
Camellya: Nah-uh, I just enjoy planting them.
Camellya: Watching them grow, waiting for them to bloom—you know, waiting makes the fruits so much sweeter.
Camellya: Of course, I have my own special seed.
Camellya: Every day, I'm consumed by the urge to see it thrive, trembling with excitement for its bloom, the soft touch of petals unfolding in my palm... This feeling... I can't wait to make it mine!
Camellya: Hehe, it's the best thing ever to watch and protect it as its breeder.
Camellya: Just a little fun of mine. Well, how's it going, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)? Enjoying your time here?
Camellya: I heard you got the Shorekeeper and all of us out of a huge mess, huh?
Yes, because I can.
Camellya: Hehe, I expected as much. You've shown great potential since you arrived in Jinzhou.
How did you know that?
Camellya: Well... I'm a Bloom Bearer, and a Bloom Bearer knows what they want to know.
If I remember correctly, you weren't here back then...
Camellya: Aww, you're a sharp one. Yes, I had something else going on, couldn't say hi to you first. What a pity.
Camellya: Didn't know the Shorekeeper would entrust a newcomer with such important tasks... She trusts you. A lot.
Camellya: You are...
Beatrice: Hey, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). It's Beatrice. Remember me from the Error Cell?
Beatrice: I hate to ask, but could you come back to the Error Cell?
Rover: What happened?
Beatrice: We've run into some trouble, and honestly, you're the only one the Shorekeeper trusts to handle it.
Beatrice: I'll explain everything when you get here.
Beatrice: Thanks a lot! And don't worry, there'll be a reward for you.
Duty calls. I have to go.
Camellya: "Oh, congratulations, (‍‍Mr.Text for male Rover‍/‍Ms.Text for female Rover‍‍) Popularity!" Whatever...
Camellya: If only you could be mine... I'd root you in my garden, where only I could savor your sweet, robust vitality... Hehe, just kidding. Hope you don't mind.
Camellya: ...How strange.
Camellya: I've felt this way before...
Camellya: Hehe, interesting.
(Head to the designated location)
Beatrice: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), there you are! It's been a while, and you still look great.
Beatrice: Since you came to the Black Shores, so many unexpected things have happened... Even the Shorekeeper made an appearance.
Beatrice: Anyway, let's get to the point. Do you remember what the Error Cell is for?
Yes.
Beatrice: Great, your memory is as sharp as ever.
Not really.
Beatrice: Well, it's basically a "prison" for containing hazardous waste like corrupted Stellar Matrices.
Beatrice: The problem is, one of the "prisoners" has escaped.
Beatrice: It's headed towards the Necrostar and seems to be trying to go even deeper.
Beatrice: The Shorekeeper is tied up with modulation and can't leave.
Beatrice: That's why I need your help to recapture it and prevent any more incidents. You're the best person for the job.
What should I do?
How much are you paying?
Beatrice: Don't worry, I'll make it worth your time.
Beatrice: The escapee is hiding, but we can use the remnants of its data to track it down.
Rover: (...I think I heard something.)
Beatrice: What's the matter?
Nothing. Go on.
Beatrice: While investigating, I discovered that a few years ago, a Consultant accessed these data.
Beatrice: She was out in the field recently and just returned to the Black Shores. You should check in with her first.
Rover: Alright. I'll call if I get anything.
Beatrice: Thank you. I'm counting on you!
(Talk to the Black Shores Consultant)
Black Shores Consultant: Hello, you must be (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), right? Beatrice filled me in on what happened.
Black Shores Consultant: The reason I looked into that Stellar Matrix is because of this little guy I found in the wild.
A small, damaged, and slightly old-looking robot quietly rests at her feet.
Black Shores Consultant: When I found it, it had been non-functional for a long time.
Black Shores Consultant: I tried to fix it, but I couldn't salvage much data... I only got this damaged recording:
KU-Riri: ...May: Majority of buildings in Petalfall Village damaged from Tacet Discord invasion. Heavy casualties. Survivors have been transferred...
KU-Riri: Threat level extremely high according to the Tethys System. The Black Shores leader has decided to handle the issue (‍‍himselfText for male Rover‍/‍herselfText for female Rover‍‍) and has departed to...
KU-Riri: (Static)... The village's remaining structures covered by highly mutated plants. Rescuing is difficult. More time needed...
KU-Riri: A... (static)... was discovered in a deep underground cave. One Overclocked Resonator named 'Lady Flora' was rescued and taken to Black Shores. Biography pending...
KU-Riri: Rabelle's Curve, this subject tends to enter the Overclocking state... currently stable... (static)...
Rover: (The Black Shores leader handled the issue (‍‍himselfText for male Rover‍/‍herselfText for female Rover‍‍)... So I brought this Lady Flora back to the Black Shores?)
Black Shores Consultant: The recording ends there. I had just joined the Black Shores back then, feeling curious about everything... especially about our leader.
Black Shores Consultant: Everything about (‍‍himText for male Rover‍/‍herText for female Rover‍‍) was shrouded in mystery, and only a select few had ever met (‍‍himText for male Rover‍/‍herText for female Rover‍‍).
Black Shores Consultant: But I didn't give up. I started looking into the other name mentioned in the recording: Lady Flora.
Black Shores Consultant: The Stellar Matrix you're hunting down contained information about Lady Flora.
Black Shores Consultant: But... I found nothing. Someone deliberately erased the data, and I'm locked out from any remaining traces.
Someone wiped everything about Lady Flora...
Black Shores Consultant: Yeah. That piqued my interest, so I asked—well, pestered—my seniors to see if I could get anything.
Black Shores Consultant: Lady Flora was said to be very close to the Black Shores leader. They were inseparable and carried out many missions together.
Black Shores Consultant: Unfortunately, Lady Flora has been missing for nearly two decades...
Rover: Missing... Seems like I can't use this clue to locate that matrix.
Black Shores Consultant: Not necessarily. You're a trusted Bloom Bearer of the Shorekeeper, right?
Black Shores Consultant: The Hall of Foreign Affairs stores a lot of information about the Black Shores personnel. Try your luck there. Maybe you'll find something.
Black Shores Consultant:
(Head to the designated location)
Black Shores Member: Hello, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), what brings you here?
(Fill him in the situation.)
Black Shores Member: Oh? But Lady Flora's item was already picked up by another Bloom Bearer.
Rover: Who took it?
Camellya: You looking for me?
Camellya: Hehe, if you want it, try to catch me!
Rover: Something's on the ground? I need to check it out.
(Head to the designated location)
Rover: Another camellia... She's never tired of these little games.
(Head to the designated location)
Rover: I guess I have no choice but to catch up with Camellya first.
(Head to the designated location)
Camellya: Oh, you're quick! I knew you wouldn't keep me waiting.
Rover: Were you following me?
Camellya: Yeah, is that a problem?
Camellya: I followed you to the cell on a whim. Then I heard something interesting.
Camellya: Plus, this thing is just finding its way back to its owner. I see no wrong in that.
Rover: To its owner... Are you that "Lady Flora"?
Camellya: Yes and no.
Camellya: Just like you, I've completely forgotten about the past! All of it! So, I guess I'm not the Lady Flora you're looking for.
You've lost your memory too...
Then how did you know you're Lady Flora?
Camellya: Of course, I did some digging, but... a little accident stopped me.
Rover: (If Camellya is Lady Flora, then we were supposed to be close, but neither of us remembers...)
Rover: (The fact that I used to be the leader... This should only be known to the Shorekeeper.)
Rover: (Maybe I shouldn't mention it to Camellya until I'm sure she's not a threat.)
Camellya: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), if you want to use that trinket to find the problematic matrix, then play with me! Entertain me, and I'll help you.
What shall we play?
What if I say no?
Camellya: Well... Then I'll take this and make a run for it!
Camellya: You can try to catch me, but be warned, it won't be an easy chase. Or, you could play along and maybe I'll let you have it. It'll be more fun that way!
Camellya: Since you handled the Threnodian, a little game of battle shouldn't be too much trouble for you, right?
Camellya: As a Bloom Bearer, I need to pick the perfect seeds for the Black Shores and give them my utmost care.
Camellya: All these years, I haven't met anyone intriguing—not one person!
Camellya: You're MY seed of fate. If I let you go so easily, all my efforts, my yearning, my hunger will not be satisfied.
Camellya: If you get taken or killed by somebody else...
Camellya: ...I would be very, very, very unhappy.
Why are you so obsessed with me?
Why do you call me your seed of fate?
Camellya: Why? It's pure instinct!
Camellya: Flowers thirst for water; beasts hunger for flesh. It's nature, just like my craving for you.
Camellya: I want it, and I get it. That's how I live.
Rover: That fleeing Stellar Matrix might affect the Necrostar's functioning. Worse, it could threaten the Black Shores.
Camellya: So? I don't care! If this island's gonna blow up, so be it. Unless, of course, it ruins my fun.
Rover: ...
Camellya: Are you angry? Hehe, your anger is sooo delicious...
Camellya: Fight me. I can't wait to see who'll be the winner. I've been itching to get a taste of your blade.
Enough small talk. I'll play.
Camellya: Hahahaha! Fantastic! Let's get started!
(During the game)
Camellya: The fresh, pulsating despair from my enemies is always delightful...
(Win the game)
Camellya: What a show. You never disappoint me. With you around, the days ahead will be so much fun.
Camellya: The game's over. Here you go, the thing I promised you. Let's keep going, my hero~
Rover: The info in that matrix is related to you. With you by my side, I should be able to locate and capture it faster.
Camellya: Hehe, alright. So...?
Rover: We need to solve this accident as soon as possible, and you promised to help if I played the game with you.
Camellya: Haha! Guess I have no other choice, huh?
Camellya: ...Well, it's lovely to see you being a little pushy too! I like your serious side. Sure, I'll go.
Rover: What else do you know about Lady Flora? You said a small accident happened during your investigation...
Camellya: Yeah, ended up stuck in a boring medical pod for half a month and almost died from severe Overclocking.
You call that a small accident?
Camellya: Sure, it's no big deal, since I survived.
Camellya: Hmm... My memories were sealed by Lady Flora somehow. No matter how much I try to recall, it doesn't work.
Camellya: I only remember waking up in a cave, my mind completely blank. Drifted aimlessly for years, until I stumbled upon the Black Shores.
Camellya: And guess what? Turns out I had lived here before! Naturally, I wanted to investigate further and figure it out.
Camellya: So that's what I did. I'm sure I uncovered the truth behind my memory loss, but... when I woke up in the medical pod again, I'd forgotten everything.
Camellya: Guess somehow I almost died from Overclocking when I learned about my past, and I had to seal my memories away again. That's pretty much what happened, I think?
Camellya: I still don't know why Lady Flora did that though... Well, I don't really care. I can have fun with or without those memories.
Rover: It doesn't sound like you're talking about your past self.
Camellya: Hello~? Are you listening? Told you I remember nothing, so... Lady Flora is more like a stranger to me.
Camellya: It's like watching a movie. No matter how happy or sad the story is, it's someone else's story, after all.
Camellya: Don't you feel the same? Tell me, what was on your mind when you witnessed those stories, staring at every frame on the screen?
Nothing.
Camellya: Haha, you don't care, do you? I knew we think alike.
...I had too many things to think about.
Camellya: Aww... You are more sentimental than I expected.
Camellya: Anyway, I'll trust my instincts over some distant memories.
Camellya: As long as my instincts remain, I'm still "me."
That sounds a bit too animalistic...
Camellya: Yeah, and what's wrong with that?
So you let your instincts define what's truly "you"?
Camellya: That's right!
Camellya: My instincts rule me, and I rule them. I feel great joy when they are fulfilled, and when I ignore them, I suffer in return.
Camellya: They guide me like how duty and responsiblity guides you... Who says one is better than the other?
No, there is no difference between these two.
Well... no comment from me.
Camellya: Hehe, let's drop this boring discussion. Shall we split up to find the other stuff?
Rover: Sure. Whoever finds it first will go meet up with the other.
Camellya: Ooh, then it's a competition—I'm in! Let the search begin!
(Search)
Rover: This Blake Bloom is...
You will be switched to Camellya's perspective.
Camellya: (‍‍HeText for male Rover‍/‍SheText for female Rover‍‍)'s sooo slow. Hehe, looks like I'm gonna win.
Camellya: Ah, I can sense my prey deep inside. So many of them...
Camellya: How wonderful.
(Defeat Tacet Discords)
Camellya: Hehe, finally, something that gets my blood pumping.
(Head to the designated location)
Camellya:Found you!
(During the fight)
Camellya: Hahaha!
Camellya: Good, good. Please me! Delight me! Entertain me!
Camellya: Oh yes, that's what I want! Keep struggling! MORE!
(Defeat the enemies)
Camellya: Ah... Wonderful...
Camellya: The way you fought really makes my heart race... Such power, such vitality...
Camellya: Ugh, I wish I were the one dancing this deadly, bloody, beautiful waltz with you...
Rover: ...I wanted to help you up.
Camellya: Hehe, I know. I was just overwhelmed with joy... Cough! Ugh...
Rover: You're on the edge of Overclocking. And you were in a medical pod before... Does this happen often?
Camellya: Yeah. Oh, are you worried about me?
Yes, can't I?
Camellya: Aww, you're sooo sweet. I'm almost blushing.
...I'm just worried that you might endanger the Black Shores.
Camellya: That's not considerate, darling. Besides, with the Tethys System here, I can't really cause any major damage.
Camellya: And I'm good at dancing on the edge. I won't let myself Overclock that easily. But if it does happen... I'll just accept it as my fate.
Rover: It's very dangerous. You know the risks, right?
Camellya: Of course I do. But once severe Overclocking symptoms appear, they can't be cured, can they?
Camellya: And I'm happy!
Camellya: It's been a blast competing and taking down those Tacet Discords with you... That's all I need to have a good time.
Camellya: If one day I die from Overclocking, so be it! The Black Shores will make sure there's no Tacet Field generated from me.
Camellya: I've always followed my instincts, ignored anything that didn't interest me. No regrets, even if I died now.
Camellya: Carpe diem, enjoy the moment... Life is boring if you're stuck in the past or consumed by the future.
Camellya: Anyway, what have you found? I got a stack of damaged photos. To locate that Stellar Matrix, we'll need three or four items tops.
I found this Blake Bloom.
Camellya: The remaining frequencies... Yes, it belongs to Lady Flora.
Camellya: It's been almost 20 years since the last frequencies were recorded.
Camellya: Blake Blooms represent a Bloom Bearer's identity. They always have one on them. These frequencies can help us track Lady Flora's last activity.
Camellya: She and the leader of Black Shores vanished at the same time, no longer appearing in records.
Rover: (Around the same time? The two cases might be connected...)
Camellya: Oh, right. I just remembered what that strange feeling I had earlier was.
Camellya: When I saw you in Jinzhou... It felt as if I'd seen you somewhere else before.
Camellya: Anyway, have you told Beatrice that we're ready?
(Inform Beatrice of your results.)
Beatrice: How impressive, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)! That's fast!
Beatrice: Please head to the Modulation Hall. I'll meet you there.
(Talk to Camellya)
Camellya: Shall we head to the Modulation Hall now?
Let's go.
No, I've got something else to handle first.
Camellya: Really? Fine... I'll be a very good girl, waiting patiently for your return, hehe.
(Talk to Beatrice)
Beatrice: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), please give me the things you just found... Oh, you want to come along, Camellya?
Camellya: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍) begged me to go with (‍‍himText for male Rover‍/‍herText for female Rover‍‍), and it looked fun, so I agreed.
Beatrice: Well, that's rare. The Camellya I know was only interested in going out to find candidates.
Beatrice: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), kudos to you for being able to get her to cooperate with you. Awesome.
Really?
Beatrice: Yeah, normally, Camellya doesn't seem to care about anything.
After all, I'm a (‍‍heroText for male Rover‍/‍heroineText for female Rover‍‍)!
Beatrice: Hehe, that's quite a confident statement, but you do have the skills to back it up.
Beatrice: With Camellya on this mission with you, you should be safer.
Beatrice: Don't worry. I'll be keeping a close eye on you.
You hand the three items to Beatrice. She records the information and then returns them to you.
Beatrice: Hold on. I need some time to process the data. Once that's done, you can dive into the Stellar Matrix with our portal.
Camellya: Past, present, future... All the possibilities in the universe change within this swirling starry sky.
Camellya: I'm starting to get a bit interested~! What kind of "me" is hidden in there?
Camellya: Let's go, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). A new adventure awaits.
Camellya: I see... (static)... something... deep...
Rover: Camellya?
Camellya: I'll catch... then meet me...
Beatrice: (Static)... what happened... (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)...
Rover: The communication cut out. Something must've happened.
Rover: Got separated from Camellya... I should check out the surroundings.
Lady Flora: I've sealed my memories, letting the past fade into nothingness.
Lady Flora: ...Did I make the right choice?
Lady Flora: But (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍) already made (‍‍hisText for male Rover‍/‍herText for female Rover‍‍) choice. Now I must make my own too.
Lady Flora: Ha... I'd rather die than live as a useless nobody.
Rover: Is that Camellya? No...
Rover: I'm inside a Stellar Matrix that holds Lady Flora's information, so it must be a simulation of some past event.
Lady Flora: Many years have passed, and here I am again...
Lady Flora: But I'm not gonna stay at the Black Shores and live off old memories.
Lady Flora: Ugh! My body's giving out... Hah... Need a place to rest soon.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Camellya's illusion disappeared.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Since she mentioned "sealed her memories" and "returned", this must be the cave from twenty years ago.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Did Camellya seal her memories because of my choice?
